bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
work="$repo/.worktrees/creator-menu-20261115"
stage="$work/.gace-menu-offline-stage"
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed/deploy
base="$root/compose.videobot.poll.yaml"
live="$repo/.worktrees/video-stars-deploy.MoCiE4eQ/live.yaml"
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = d8de8f8912ee1d19b2a2bf2171c6cb66d51783a5 || { echo SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 74; }
test -f "$base" && test -f "$live" || { echo COMPOSE_FILES_CHANGED; exit 74; }
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1)" = gace-createvdobot || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1)" = videobot-poll || exit 74
test "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8)" = sha256:ee5a183876e7a9dfa437d49cc484afdaeef4cd386222603d461a705e3128c2da || { echo CANDIDATE_IMAGE_MISMATCH; exit 74; }
old="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1)"
docker image tag "$old" create-videobot:rollback-pre-menu-20261115
cat > "$stage/override.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8
    pull_policy: never
YAML
cat > "$stage/rollback.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:rollback-pre-menu-20261115
    pull_policy: never
YAML
compose=(docker compose -p gace-createvdobot --project-directory "$root" -f "$base" -f "$live")
"${compose[@]}" -f "$stage/override.yaml" config --quiet || { echo COMPOSE_PREFLIGHT_FAILED; exit 76; }
echo "COMPOSE_PREFLIGHT=PASS"
"${compose[@]}" -f "$stage/override.yaml" up --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate -d videobot-poll || { echo DEPLOY_COMMAND_FAILED; exit 1; }
sleep 10
state="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1)"
image="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1)"
if test "$state" != running || test "$image" != sha256:ee5a183876e7a9dfa437d49cc484afdaeef4cd386222603d461a705e3128c2da; then
 echo "NEW_IMAGE_UNHEALTHY; state=$state"
 "${compose[@]}" -f "$stage/rollback.yaml" up --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate -d videobot-poll || echo ROLLBACK_COMMAND_FAILED
 echo "CREATOR_DEPLOY_VERIFY=FAIL"
 exit 1
fi
echo "CREATEVDO_CONTAINER_IMAGE=$image"
echo "CREATEVDO_RUNNING=PASS"
echo "CREATOR_POLL_READY=$(docker logs --since 3m gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 2>&1 | grep -q 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS' && echo PASS || echo NOT_OBSERVED)"
echo "STICKER_SHOP_READY=$(docker logs --since 3m gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 2>&1 | grep -q 'STICKER_SHOP_HTTP_READY=PASS' && echo PASS || echo NOT_OBSERVED)"
echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo "CREATEVDO_DEPLOY_VERIFY=PASS"
